title: Separate Financial Statements
summary: Prescribes the accounting and disclosure in an entity's separate financial statements for investments in subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates, converged with IAS 27, with a genuine mandatory standalone filing divergence.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS – Converged with IAS 27, with a Genuine Mandatory Filing Divergence
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 27's measurement options for investments in subsidiaries/JVs/associates mirror IAS 27 closely. The distinctive Indian feature is that the Companies Act, 2013 MANDATES every Indian company to prepare and file STANDALONE (separate) financial statements, REGARDLESS of whether it also prepares consolidated financial statements – unlike many IFRS jurisdictions where separate FS preparation may not be a legal requirement. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
